original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚警察总监视察尼日尔州，承诺彻查37名疑似矿工死亡事件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏前往尼日尔州首府明纳，会见州长乌马尔·巴戈，承诺将彻查37名疑似非法矿工在尼日利亚安全与民防部队羁押期间死亡的事件。迪苏称警方有责任调查羁押期间死亡事件，将与民防部队及州政府合作查明死因。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Niger State Government House in Minna

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏视察尼日尔州并承诺彻查37名疑似矿工死亡事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, has visited Niger State Governor Umar Bago and vowed that the police would leave no stone unturned in unraveling the circumstances surrounding the deaths of 37 suspected illegal miners in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps.

key_facts.fact: 37名疑似非法矿工在尼日利亚安全与民防部队羁押期间死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the deaths of 37 suspected illegal miners in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps

key_facts.fact: 迪苏在明纳尼日尔州政府大楼会见州长巴戈
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Disu, who arrived at the Niger State Government House in Minna on Friday

key_facts.fact: 警方将与民防部队及州政府合作查明死因
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the police would work with the NSCDC and the state government to establish what led to the deaths

uncertainties: 矿工死亡的具体原因和经过尚未查明
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
37名死者身份为疑似非法矿工，有待核实
